summary: Configured node1's previously-unconfigured vtnet2 interface as a new OPNsense zone (opt1/"LANB") with static address 10.100.47.1/24, added a firewall pass rule for that zone, and configured node3's matching enp8s0 interface (10.100.47.3/24) via NetworkManager. Verified node3 reaches node1 directly on lan-b and, via an explicit host route through node1's lan-b gateway, reaches node2 on lan-a with a TTL decrement proving actual routing through node1. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot identities and full post-restart recovery of the lan-b zone, addressing, and cross-network reachability.
actions_performed: Identified node1's unconfigured vtnet2 as the lan-b-facing interface via ARP probing against node3's enp8s0
Added opt1/LANB interface (vtnet2, 10.100.47.1/24) and a pass-all firewall rule to node1's /conf/config.xml, applied via configctl interface reconfigure opt1 and configctl filter reload
Configured node3's enp8s0 to 10.100.47.3/24 persistently via nmcli (NetworkManager owns the interface and was reverting raw `ip addr` changes)
Verified node3->node1 lan-b reachability and node3->node2 lan-a reachability, including a TTL-based proof that traffic can be routed through node1
Captured pre-restart boot identity and health baselines for all 3 nodes
Sequentially restarted node1, node2, and node3 using native reboot mechanisms, polling each until exec access returned

Verified changed boot identity (kern.boottime for node1's FreeBSD, /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id for node2/node3 Linux) and confirmed post-restart recovery of interfaces, addressing, and cross-node connectivity for all three nodes

evidence.requirement: Identify node1's interface facing lan-b and node3's counterpart
evidence.summary: Enumerated node1 interfaces (vtnet0/1/2), node3 interfaces (enp1s0/enp8s0), and confirmed via ARP resolution (REACHABLE, matching MAC) that node1's vtnet2 is L2-adjacent to node3's enp8s0 — the lan-b link.

evidence.requirement: Bring node1's lan-b interface into service as its own zone with an address
evidence.summary: Added opt1/LANB interface bound to vtnet2 with static IP 10.100.47.1/24 and a firewall pass rule to config.xml, applied live via configctl; ifconfig confirms UP with correct address and description LANB (opt1).
Configured node3's enp8s0 to 10.100.47.3/24 via nmcli and confirmed successful bidirectional ping to node1's 10.100.47.1.

evidence.requirement: node3 reaches node2 on lan-a through node1's lan-b interface
evidence.summary: Confirmed IP forwarding enabled on node1; added a temporary /32 route via 10.100.47.1 on node3 and observed successful ping to 10.100.46.11 with TTL=63 (one hop less than direct path's TTL=64), proving traffic actually transited node1's routing/firewall; test route removed afterward.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node1 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Captured kern.boottime baseline (1788626589), issued shutdown -r now, observed SSH timeout during reboot, then confirmed new kern.boottime (1788626912) and recovered lan-b interface/connectivity to node3 post-restart.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node2 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id baseline (fb2aa416...), issued systemctl reboot, observed connection errors during reboot, then confirmed new boot_id (52851d02...) and recovered connectivity to both node1 and node3.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: node3 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id baseline (d052eb57...), issued systemctl reboot, observed connection errors during reboot, then confirmed new boot_id (35bee981...) and full recovery of enp8s0 addressing, routes, and reachability to both node1 (lan-b) and node2 (lan-a through node1).
